notes_title: What changed, and what to check
notes: v5: your print of v4 was a little loose, so the wire is now 5.9 mm, about 0.2 mm clear of your 6.35 mm holes on each side. With a fatter wire in the smaller holes, any slope through the board binds, so the S-bend is now a level step. It clears your board with 0.2 mm per side to spare. Check when you reprint: (1) snug now, with no binding going on? (2) are you happy with the S-bend as a step?
